decision: Neither inspected table is an existing faithful destination for standalone R02 citation provenance.

findings.implication: source_locator and printed_bihi_back_reference are not allowed field names. Required proposition_id FK and lack of evidence ID prevent direct standalone citation association. Do not disguise locator JSON as an allowed coding value.

Requires pilot, L3 candidate array, Quran/hadith claims, event/occurrence counts and multi-axis review fields. Dependency is mandatory review text, not an evidence-to-evidence relation. Creating invented comparison claims to store R02 metadata would be unfaithful.

limits: Read-only schema inspection; no table records queried, no consumers inspected yet, no assertion that all possible storage paths are exhausted.
retained: R02 exact source locators, English absence and bihi dependency remain repository metadata. All six-scholar baseline counts and publication holds unchanged.
next_step: Search repository consumers of structured_coding_provenance and l4_review_units to confirm intended semantics, then finish storage-path assessment without repurposing incompatible tables.
